text: The environment feels modern and intentionally designed, a blend of practical spaces and conceptual exhibitions. The glass meeting room invites thoughts of collaboration and shared goals. Moving to the wall exhibit, I feel curiosity stirred by the emphasis on research and development—the human urge to understand, create, and redefine our connection with technology. Here, surrounded by ideas and innovation, I feel both challenged and inspired, as if I am part of a continuous dialogue between what we know and what we are yet to discover.
